nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address stored by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Mapping(address => uint) token balances; written in the constructor, transfer, and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)); written/read by approve, transferFrom, allowance and approveAndCall.
Fixed total token supply (108000000) assigned in the constructor.
SafeMath.add(uint a, uint b): checked addition with require(c >= a).
SafeMath.sub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.mul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication; unused by the token logic.
SafeMath.div(uint a, uint b): division with require(b > 0); unused by the token logic.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) public onlyOwner: stages a new owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership() public: requires msg.sender == newOwner, then transfers ownership and clears newOwner.
totalSupply() public view: returns _totalSupply.sub(balances[address(0)]).
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) public view: returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens) public returns (bool): checks balances[msg.sender] >= tokens, tokens > 0 and no overflow, then moves balances and emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) public returns (bool): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) public returns (bool): subtracts from balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], adds to balances[to].
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) public view: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) public: sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) before returning.
Fallback function: payable but always reverts, so ETH transfers are rejected.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) public onlyOwner: external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, authorization checks and balance/allowance lookups.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary, possibly malicious, token contract.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership; staged owner address.
Parameter to of transfer; recipient of tokens.
Parameter tokens of transfer; amount moved.
Parameter spender of approve; address granted an allowance.
Parameter tokens of approve; allowance amount written to allowed.
Parameter from of transferFrom; debited account.
Parameter to of transferFrom; credited account.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom; amount moved.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall; also the target contract of the external call.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall; allowance amount and callback amount.
Parameter data of approveAndCall; opaque bytes forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token; arbitrary ERC20 contract address.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token; amount transferred to owner.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged address.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before staging a new owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to complete the ownership handover.
msg.sender indexes balances in the transfer guard and debit.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written in approve.
msg.sender indexes allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
msg.sender is written into allowed and forwarded as the from argument of receiveApproval.
onlyOwner modifier gates the arbitrary token rescue function on msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument to the external receiveApproval callback.
transferOwnership reads the owner state variable via the onlyOwner guard.
acceptOwnership reads owner for the OwnershipTransferred event and then overwrites it.
Constructor mints the entire supply to balances[owner].
transferAnyERC20Token sends the rescued tokens to the owner address.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the authorization check, event and owner assignment.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for msg.sender and to.
transferFrom reads and writes balances for from and to.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom reads and debits allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before invoking the callback.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Constructor assigns _totalSupply into balances[owner] as the initial mint.
SafeMath.sub computes the circulating supply in totalSupply.
SafeMath.sub debits balances[msg.sender] in transfer.
SafeMath.sub debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
SafeMath.add credits balances[to] in transfer.
SafeMath.add credits balances[to] in transferFrom.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an arbitrary spender contract after updating the allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary ERC20 contract.
The spender contract invoked by receiveApproval can re-enter transfer during the external call.
The spender contract can re-enter approve and rewrite allowances while the callback executes.
The spender contract can re-enter transferFrom using the freshly granted allowance.
Caller-supplied spender parameter is the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
Caller-supplied tokenAddress parameter is the target contract of the external transfer call.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
to parameter is the credit destination in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount checked and moved in transfer.
spender parameter keys the allowance written in approve.
tokens parameter is the allowance value written in approve.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount debited from balance and allowance in transferFrom.
spender parameter keys the allowance and receives the callback in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is the allowance and callback amount in approveAndCall.
data parameter is forwarded as the opaque payload to receiveApproval.
tokenAddress parameter selects the ERC20 contract to call and rescue from.
tokens parameter is the amount forwarded to the external ERC20 transfer call.

normalization_plan.reason: _newOwner is used only to write the newOwner state variable inside transferOwnership; it carries no independent security semantics.
to is only the recipient index of balances inside transfer, so it can be folded into that function node.
tokens is only the transferred amount validated and moved inside transfer.
spender is only the allowance key written by approve.
tokens is only the allowance value written by approve.
from is only the debited account handled by transferFrom.
to is only the credited account handled by transferFrom.
tokens is only the transferred amount handled by transferFrom.
spender is the allowance key and the external call target, both fully defined by approveAndCall.
tokens is the allowance and callback amount consumed only by approveAndCall.
data is the opaque payload forwarded only by approveAndCall to receiveApproval.
tokenAddress is the external call target used only by transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens is the amount forwarded only by transferAnyERC20Token to the external ERC20 call.
